card.name: Saiyan Cabba
card.skill: [Auto]  When this card attacks, you may choose 1 card from your life and add it to your hand.  If you do so, this card gains +10000 power and [Double Strike]  (This card inflicts 2 damage instead of 1 when attacking) for the duration of the turn.

qa.q: When adding cards from your Life Area to your hand with {BT1-014 Saiyan Cabba}’s auto skill, can you choose which card to add to your hand?
qa.a: You can, but you cannot look at the card beforehand.

card.name: Unceasing Evolution Frost
card.skill: [evolve] {r}{r}: <Frost> (Play this card on top of the specified card)[double strike] (This card inflicts 2 damage instead of 1 when attacking)

card.name: Broly, Unrealized Ambition
card.skill:
[Auto] When you play this card from your hand and if your Leader Card is a green ≪Frieza's Army≫ card, choose 2 cards from your life and add them to your hand.
[Auto] When this card is removed from a Battle Area by a skill or KO'd, and if your Leader Card is a green ≪Frieza's Army≫ card, choose 1 or 2 cards from your life and add them to your hand, then choose up to 1 green <Broly: Br> card with an energy cost of 4 from your hand and play it.

qa.q: When this card is moved to a non-open area by an opponent’s skill, can you activate and resolve this card’s auto skill?
This card’s effect was negated by {BT1-107 Cold Bloodlust}. If it then leaves the Battle Area by your opponent’s skill, does this card’s auto skill activate and resolve?
If this card is placed under one of your opponent’s cards by your opponent’s skill, does this card’s auto skill activate and resolve?
qa.a: Yes, it activates. The master of the Battle Area prior to the card changing control becomes the master of this skill, and activates and resolves it.

qa.q: If this card is placed under one of your cards by your skill, does this card’s auto skill activate and resolve?
If your opponent gains control of this card with one of their skills, does this card’s auto skill activate and resolve?
qa.a: Yes, it activates. The master of the Battle Area prior to the card changing control becomes the master of this skill, and activates and resolves it.

qa.q: If this card is KO’d or leaves the Battle Area after your opponent gains control of it, does its auto skill activate and resolve?
qa.a: Yes, the auto skill activates. However, since your opponent is the master of the skill, your opponent activates and resolves it.

qa.q: When you are prevented from adding cards in your life to your hand by this card’s auto skill, does the “choose up to 1 green 〈Broly : Br〉 card with an energy cost of 4 from your hand and play it” skill resolve?
When this card has its power lowered by a skill, resulting in its power being lowered to 0 or lower and sent to its owner’s Drop Area, can you activate and resolve this card’s auto skill?

card.name: Android 17, Infinite Rotation
card.skill:
[auto][limit 1]{r}, if your Leader is a red ≪Android≫ card: At the end of a battle in which your Battle Card attacked, play this card from under a {Destroyed West City} in your Battle Area.
[auto][limit 1] When this card in your hand is placed under a {Destroyed West City} in your Battle Area, place up to 1 red card from your deck under a Z-Extra in your Battle Area, then shuffle your deck.

card.name: Abducted
card.skill:
[permanent] Negate the skills of Battle Cards on top of this card, and those cards can't attack.
[activate: main] Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards with in its character name and place this card under it from your Drop after this card is activated.
[activate: main]{2}: Place this card in your Drop from under a Battle Card with in its character name.

card.name: SSB Son Goku & SSB Vegeta, Battle With a God
card.skill:
[Deflect][Dual Attack]
[Permanent] If your Leader is a black <Son Goku>-only card and you have 3 or more energy, reduce the energy cost of this card in your Z-Deck by {b}{w}.
[Auto] When this card is played, send up to 1 card from your Drop to its owner's Warp.
[Auto][Limit 1] When this card is placed under a <Vegito> card with a [Union] skill, choose up to 1 of your cards and switch it to Revealed Mode.

card.name: Lightning Speed Vegito
card.skill:
[Union-Potara] ③: <Son Goku> and <Vegeta> (Place this card in Active Mode on top of the 2 specified cards stacked together)
[Permanent] This card can attack Battle Cards that are in Active Mode.
[Auto] At the end of the battle after this card attacks, place 10 cards from the top of your deck in your Drop Area. Then, choose up to 1 <Vegito> with 25000 power from your Drop Area and evolve into it by placing it on top of this card in Active Mode.

qa.q: You use [Union-Potara] to play a card on top of a card that received +5000 power and [Double Strike] for the duration of the turn. Do these power boosts and skills transfer to the new card?
qa.a: The new card retains the +5000 power boost, but does not receive [Double Strike]. When playing cards on top of other cards, only changes to power transfer. Any skills granted to the cards placed below do not.

qa.q: Can you attack your own Battle Cards in Active Mode?
Can you evolve into {BT2-012 Repeated Force Vegito} with {BT2-013 Lightning Speed Vegito}’s skill?
qa.a:
Yes, you can.
{BT2-012 Repeated Force Vegito} has 25000 power, and its character name is "Vegito," so the specified conditions are fulfilled.

qa.q: Do you need to pay the energy cost or [Evolve] cost for cards evolved via card skills?
qa.a: No, you do not need to pay the unless specified otherwise.

qa.q: If this card attacks a Battle Card with [Revenge], does its auto skill activate at the end of the battle?

card.name: Destroyed West City
card.skill:
[Z-Stack 1] {Time Machine Departure} or {Accel Dance}.
[Permanent] If your Leader is a red <Son Gohan: Future> or <Gohanks: Xeno> card or a red card with both <Android 17> and <Android 18>, reduce the energy cost of this card in your Z-Deck by 5.
[Activate: Main][Once per turn] Place 1 red ≪Saiyan≫ or ≪Android≫ card from your hand under this card: Draw 1 card.
